popis.t: Gebo is the gift that comes into being between two sides: one hand gives, the other receives, and something begins that was not there before.
popis.z: RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: jedna ruka podává, druhá přijímá, vzniká, co předtím nebylo

popis.t: Gebo is giving and receiving without a ledger: not a trade, and not a debt of one side to the other.
popis.z: RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: není obchod ani účetnictví; k: giving and receiving

popis.t: Gebo is the space that opens between two when something passes from one hand to the other, and it belongs to both.
popis.z: RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: prostor, který patří oběma; coll_rune: the space between the hands

popis.t: Gebo is drawn as two strokes that cross: two sides meeting at one point, neither taking the other's place.
popis.z: tvar runy X (fakt); setkání dvou stran, žádná nepohltí druhou (Gemini, krok 33)

napeti.t: a gift can show a bond, or try to buy one
napeti.z: katalog 1: vyjadřuje dar vztah, nebo se jím vztah kupuje

napeti.t: giving because one wants to, or giving and keeping a tally
napeti.z: katalog 2: dávám, protože chci, nebo si zapisuji

napeti.t: to take a gift can mean saying yes to something one never asked for
a gift with a hook leaves the debt in place even after the thanks are gone
napeti.z: katalog 4 (Tsang 2006); RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: vynucený dar není dar

napeti.t: giving what the other needs, or what feels good to give
two who do not give the same can still stand even
napeti.z: katalog 6; RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: vztah není výměnou, pokud jedna strana musí stále platit

napeti.t: what one meant to give and what the other received are not always the same thing

bez_pocitani.t: giving without counting, which means letting go of the reply as well
bez_pocitani.z: Gemini cesta 1; RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: dát bez jistoty, že se vrátí

zastavit.t: stopping an exchange that runs only one way, which keeps room for one that runs both ways
zastavit.z: Gemini cesta 2; RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: jedna strana nesmí stále platit

prijmout.t: receiving without repaying at once, which leaves the other the joy of having given
prijmout.z: Gemini cesta 3; RUNAR_POPISY_RUN: přijmout, aniž bys hned vracel

dekovat.t: thanks said plainly, which can carry more than a gift in return
dekovat.z: katalog 1–2: vděčnost sbližuje, oplátka mezi blízkými ochlazuje (Algoe 2008, Clark & Mills 1979)

maly.t: a small gift, which can be enough, because size is not what binds two people
maly.z: katalog 2: Hávamál 52 „oft kaupir sér í litlu lof“

vratit.t: handing back a gift that comes with a claim, which leaves both sides free
vratit.z: katalog 3–4: nevyžádaný dar jako nárok (Belk & Coon 1993); vynucený dar není dar
